**2 — Vessel:** A large square dinner plate, approximately 26 cm across. Its area is about 676 cm²—equivalent to a circular diameter of 29.3 cm: \(3.14 × (29.3/2)^2 ≈ 674\) cm². I use **675 cm²** below.

**3 — Items:** Chicken drumstick, green beans, mixed lettuce with carrot slivers, roasted orange vegetables (probably sweet potato), grilled white cheese (possibly halloumi or paneer), and a small amount of visible oil/dressing.
